rules.description: Hiraia native downloads and telemetry: skip browser-only integrity check
rules.expression: ((http.host in {"assets.hiraia.org" "hiraia.org" "www.hiraia.org"} and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/models/") and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) or (http.host in {"hiraia.org" "www.hiraia.org"} and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/telemetry/batch" and http.request.method eq "POST"))
